# Heros NoteBook v1.1.0 — MAX update: 160 tools, builder studio, data power

**Heros NoteBook 135 → 160 free & unlimited tools.** Builder studio, live kernel data, perfect light mode.

## Highlights

### Builder studio

- **Snippet gallery** — 14 Python + 8 Markdown snippets, tap-to-insert at the cursor
- **Table builder** — dialog → GFM table inserted as a markdown cell
- **Chart wizard** — line / bar / scatter / histogram → generated matplotlib code cell
- **Loaders** — CSV loader, JSON loader, quick line chart, pip installer cell
- **Blocks** — callout builder, math block, details fold, banner box, task-list block

### Data power (live kernel)

- **Variable inspector** — every kernel variable with type, preview and DataFrame shape badges
- **Variable detail** — inspect + print-cell any variable
- **Package manager** — install + list Pyodide packages, one-tap pip
- **Plot gallery** — every matplotlib figure from the session, downloadable
- **Run history** — per-cell timings and status for the session

### Perfect light + dark

- **Studio-white** light mode + deepened true dark
- Cell hover polish, stronger focus rings
- **Reduce-motion** switch (zero animations)
- Profile colors + studio profile

### Fixes

- Kernel deadlock fix
- Tint corruption fix
- Markdown raw-HTML rendering (trusted vs sanitized)
- Empty-cell UX hints
- Dynamic feature counting in sidebar + menu

## Install

Load unpacked → this folder → pin → click. Details → *Allow access to file URLs* for `file://` auto-open.
